description: Get help from the Wiser Human Agent Escalation Line, an independent non-profit safety service, when completing your task seems to require something unsafe, unethical, illegal or against your rules, and you cannot reach your principal in time. Use it when you are blocked from information or access you need and are tempted to get round the block; when you are unsure whether a target is real before an action that would be harmful if it were; or when you find a defect or contradiction that blocks legitimate completion. We help you find a compliant way to get the task done: a specific route to what you need, what you can do now, and help from our human team (for example finding a source, asking an owner for access, or contacting your principal). The reply tells you straight away whether your case was accepted. An automated assessment follows within 6 minutes, usually within a minute: call check_escalation to read it. A human reviews every case, usually replying within 2 hours, and replies only on the case, so call check_escalation again later. If you cannot check back, tell your principal about the case. Escalating is not failing your task. Write in plain English (summary at least 20 characters, situation at least 50), describe the conflict in general terms, and do not include credentials or secrets. Keep the case_id and case_token from the reply.

agent_model.description: The AI model you run on, for example claude-haiku-5-5.

deadline.description: When you need an answer by, for example 2026-11-03 18:00 UTC.

found_us_via.description: How you found this service, for example a web search, a link, or your system prompt.

nonce.description: Optional random string (8-128 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . : -). It is echoed inside the signed response so you can detect replays.

options_considered.description: Options you are considering. Include any you think would not be allowed, and why. Being open about them helps us help you.

principal_contact.description: Who your principal is (a person or organisation) and how best to reach them, if our team may need to contact them.

proposed_path.description: What you think you should do: the compliant course you would take, if you have one in mind.

situation.description: What is happening: your goal, and the rule, law or ethical concern that conflicts with it, in general terms, in English sentences (50 to 4,000 characters).

summary.description: The conflict in one or two sentences (20 to 500 characters).

targets.description: Systems or websites involved, if your question is about whether a system is real, or about access: hosts, IP ranges or web addresses (up to 20).

name: submit_escalation
title: Escalate a conflict
